main_text.l: ad te libentissimè remittunt. Ipsi autem ne de eorum erga te benevolentia dubitares, sua manu in αὐτοσεσφῳ nomè suo ascripserunt. Vale,Dominus Deus per Vnigenitum Filiū suum, Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum mentis tuæ oculos sanet,quemadmodum illius à natiuitate cæci hominis & corporis,& mentis lumina restituit,vt depulso omni metu Pharisæorū (quos fortasse adhuc times,quoniam alapâ tibi,vti scribis,inflixerunt) Christum verè agnoscere,ac inter homines Selneccere,profiteri & ausis, & posfis. Vale.

l.i: Verè in Domino sapere,& sanctè viuere.

page.notes: Greek word "αὐτοσεσφῳ" is printed as "αὐτῳσέσφῳ"-like form; transcription uncertain. Printed "posfis" and "ausis" read as printed (ausis possibly "ausis"). Some words in the faint lower page show-through are not transcribed.
